query: Build reliable HTTP services backed by a relational database
rubric: Strong: explicit experience building server APIs and relational storage; partial: adjacent web development without both.

query: Keep scheduled data transformations running and recover failed jobs
rubric: Strong: pipeline orchestration and scheduled ETL; partial: data processing without orchestration.

query: Build interfaces that people can navigate without a mouse
rubric: Strong: explicit accessibility and keyboard navigation; partial: frontend delivery without accessibility evidence.

query: Manage infrastructure as code and deploy containerized services
rubric: Strong: infrastructure provisioning and container operations; partial: only one.

query: Train prediction models and expose them to product applications
rubric: Strong: model training and serving; partial: application integration without training.

query: Improve which documents appear first when customers search
rubric: Strong: relevance or ranking evaluation and search implementation; partial: keyword search implementation alone.

query: Own both a React interface and the API behind it
rubric: Strong: explicit React and server API ownership; partial: React only.

query: Process events arriving out of order without losing data
rubric: Strong: streaming and late-event handling; partial: queues without ordering or reconciliation evidence.

query: Ship phone apps that continue to work without internet access
rubric: Strong: native mobile and offline synchronization; partial: mobile experience without offline evidence.

query: Build trusted warehouse tables and check freshness
rubric: Strong: warehouse modeling and freshness checks; partial: SQL work without warehouse quality controls.

query: Make generated answers traceable to source documents
rubric: Strong: LLM source citations and answer evaluation; partial: search without generated-answer review.

query: Reduce repeated database reads by caching requests
rubric: Strong: cache implementation and latency measurement; partial: performance work without caching evidence.

query: Implement safe asynchronous retries and idempotent consumers
rubric: Strong: explicit idempotent queue consumers; partial: retries or dead-letter handling alone.

query: Catch regressions automatically before releasing software
rubric: Strong: integration tests and release checks; partial: testing mentioned without automation.

query: Run Python services with production monitoring
rubric: Strong: Python services and monitoring; partial: Python outside service operation.

query: Operate Kubernetes services and roll back failed changes
rubric: Strong: Kubernetes operations and rollback procedures; partial: containers without rollback evidence.

query: Deliver accessible TypeScript web experiences
rubric: Strong: TypeScript UI work with explicit accessibility; partial: TypeScript UI without accessibility.

query: Build Kafka consumers that route failed events for later recovery
rubric: Strong: Kafka and dead-letter queues; partial: Kafka streaming without recovery evidence.

query: Evaluate search quality and maintain indexing jobs
rubric: Strong: relevance evaluation and indexing work; partial: only one.

query: Provision reproducible cloud environments and write incident runbooks
rubric: Strong: infrastructure automation, reproducibility and runbooks; partial: provisioning alone.

query: Build retrieval augmented generation with both vector retrieval and cited answers
rubric: Strong requires explicit vector retrieval AND cited generation. Partial: citations or keyword search alone; do not infer vector experience.

query: Maintain distributed transactions and consensus protocols
rubric: Strong requires explicit transaction or consensus implementation. Generic backend work is not sufficient; zero relevant profiles is acceptable.

query: Train computer vision models for medical images
rubric: Strong requires vision and medical-image evidence. General ML is adjacent at most; do not infer domain expertise.

query: Make SQL analytics reliable while processing continuous event streams
rubric: Strong: SQL reconciliation plus continuous event processing; partial: only analytics or only streaming.

query: Build audited payment systems with fraud detection
rubric: Strong requires explicit payments, auditability and fraud experience. Generic APIs or models alone are not sufficient.

query: Deliver a user-facing assistant and evaluate the answers it produces
rubric: Strong: assistant UI delivery and answer evaluation; partial: UI work or model serving without answer evaluation.

query: Implement database access controls and security threat modeling
rubric: Strong requires explicit access-control implementation and threat modeling. Database familiarity alone is insufficient.

query: Develop high-performance C++ rendering engines
rubric: Strong requires C++ and rendering evidence. Unrelated frontend or performance work is not a match.

query: Work across warehouse quality checks and event delivery reliability
rubric: Strong: warehouse modeling or freshness plus retries, queues, or dead letters; partial: one side only.

query: Build a Go service while operating cloud infrastructure
rubric: Strong: explicit Go service delivery and cloud operations; partial: Go without operations evidence.
